Database ​

Every method throws SkapiError with a code and a message. Records are returned as JSON objects; the shape is in The record.

Common errors ​

These can come from any method below that takes the input or needs the state.

codemessagewhen
INVALID_REQUESTUser login is required.the method needs a signed-in user
INVALID_PARAMETER"<field>" should be type: <string>. / "<field>" is required.a name is missing or not a string
INVALID_PARAMETER"<field>" should be <= 256 characters.a table, index or tag name (or string value) is too long; / ! * # % count as 3 each
INVALID_PARAMETER"<field>" cannot include control characters or unsupported sentinel characters.
INVALID_PARAMETER"<field>" cannot start with "$".a custom index name
INVALID_PARAMETER"<value>" is invalid in "condition". allowed types or values are: ...an unknown condition
INVALID_PARAMETERNumber value should be within range -4503599627370496 ~ +4503599627370496an index number out of range
INVALID_PARAMETER"table.access_group" is invalid. / "table.access_group" should be type: <number | string>. / "table.access_group" value should be within a range of 0 ~ 99.
INVALID_PARAMETERUnsigned users have no access to records with access group.signed out, with an access group other than "public"
INVALID_PARAMETERUser ID is empty. / User ID should be type: string. / User ID is invalid.a user ID (the field name varies)
INVALID_REQUESTFetch limit should be below 1000.FetchOptions.limit
INVALID_PARAMETER"<value>" is invalid startKey key.startKey is not an object, "start" or "end"
NETWORK_ERRORNetwork errorno answer came back
TOO_MANY_REQUESTSToo many requests: ...still refused after 6 automatic retries

fetchOptions is a FetchOptions: limit, fetchMore, ascending, startKey. See Paging. Methods that take it return {"list": [...], "startKey": ..., "endOfList": Bool, "startKeyHistory": [...]}.

postRecord ​

swift
func postRecord(_ data: JSON? = nil, config: JSON, files: [UploadFile]? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Creates a record, or updates the one named by config["record_id"]. Returns the saved record. See Creating Records and Updating.

argument
dataAny JSON value, up to 2 MB. Left out (or nil): keep the stored data. .null: store null. config["data"], when present, is used instead.
configRequired. Keys below.
filesUploadFiles to attach. See Files.
config keytype
tableobject["name", "access_group"]. Required unless record_id is given. On create a left-out group is "public"; on update it keeps the record's group.
record_idstringThe record (or unique ID) to update.
unique_idstring or nullnull removes it.
readonlybool
indexobject or null["name": String, "value": string, number or bool]. null removes it.
tagsarray of strings, or a comma-separated stringnull or [] removes them.
referencestring, ["record_id"], ["unique_id"] or nullnull removes it.
sourceobjectreferencing_limit (number or null), prevent_multiple_referencing, can_remove_referencing_records, only_granted_can_reference, allow_granted_to_grant_others (bools), referencing_index_restrictions (array of ["name", "value"?, "condition"?]). See Reference rules.
remove_binarray of URLs or bin objects, or nullFiles to remove. null removes every file; [] removes nothing.

Inside a config, null is written nil in a literal or .null elsewhere: ["record_id": "<record id>", "index": nil].

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_PARAMETER"config" argument is required.
INVALID_PARAMETER"table.name" is required.
INVALID_PARAMETER<value> is invalid in "table". allowed types or values are: Type<string>, Type<object>.
INVALID_PARAMETER<value> is invalid in "unique_id". allowed types or values are: Type<string>, null.
INVALID_PARAMETER<value> is invalid in "readonly". allowed type or value is: Type<boolean>.
INVALID_PARAMETER"index" should be type: <object | null>.
INVALID_PARAMETER"tag" should be type: <string | string[]>.
INVALID_PARAMETER"reference" should be type: <string | object>. / "reference.unique_id" should be type: <string>.
INVALID_PARAMETER"remove_bin" should be type: <string[] | BinaryFile[] | null>
INVALID_PARAMETER"reference_limit" should be type: <number | null> / "reference_limit" should be >= 0
INVALID_PARAMETER"source.<key>" should be type: <boolean>.
INVALID_PARAMETERKey "name" is required. (an index restriction without name)
INVALID_PARAMETERIndex restriction "range" type should match the type of "value". (any restriction with range)
INVALID_PARAMETER"files[<i>]" should have a field name. / "files[<i>].filename" is required for bytes.
INVALID_PARAMETER"files[<i>].file" cannot be read: <reason>.
INVALID_REQUESTData should not exceed 2MB
INVALID_REQUESTPublic users can only post records to public tables. / Public users cannot update existing records. / Public users cannot set unique_id for records. / Public users cannot remove files from records. / Public users cannot post subscription records.
INVALID_REQUESTUser has no access to update this record.
INVALID_REQUESTRecord is read only.
INVALID_REQUESTOnly the owner of a record can move it into or out of the private access group. / User has no access to change the private access of the record.
INVALID_REQUEST"__data__/__json__.json" is a reserved file name. (a file named __json__.json under the name __data__)

The files are read and checked before the record is saved. A file that storage refuses after the record is saved throws nothing.

postRecords ​

swift
func postRecords(_ items: [JSON]) async throws -> JSON

Saves many records, 100 to a request. Each item is ["data"?: ..., "config": [...]] with the keys of postRecord; files are not supported. Returns:

json
{"list": [record, ...], "failed": [{"index": 7, "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER", "message": "..."}, ...]}

A refused item is listed in failed with the error postRecord would have thrown, and does not stop the others. A failed request (network, sign-in, server) throws, and records saved before it stay saved. See Many records at once.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_PARAMETER"items" should be a non-empty array.
in failed"items[<i>]" should be an object with "config". / "items[<i>].config" is required.
in failed, INVALID_REQUESTThis encrypted update is over 256 KB once sealed; save it with postRecord().
in failed, ERRORThe server answered nothing for this record. / The record was not saved.

getRecords ​

swift
func getRecords(_ query: JSON? = nil, fetchOptions: FetchOptions? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Returns {"list": [record, ...], "startKey", "endOfList", "startKeyHistory"}. See Fetching Records.

query keytype
record_idstringOne record. Every other key is ignored.
unique_idstringOne record by unique ID. Ignored when record_id is given.
tableobject["name", "access_group"], both required. Needed except with record_id, unique_id or (signed in) reference.
referencestring, or ["record_id"], ["unique_id"], ["user_id"]Records that reference this record, or records this user uploaded.
indexobject["name", "value", "condition"?, "range"?]. name may be "$uploaded", "$updated", "$referenced_count" (number values) or "$user_id" (a user ID). condition: "=", ">", ">=", "<", "<=", "eq", "gt", "gte", "lt", "lte". With both condition and range, range is dropped. See Indexes.
tagstringExact tag.

table written as a plain string is deprecated: it still means ["name": ..., "access_group": "public"], without a warning.

Errors ​

codemessage
REQUIRE_LOGINThis project requires users to sign in before reading its database, so "getRecords" is not available to a signed-out visitor.
INVALID_PARAMETER"table.access_group" is required: a table is always { name, access_group }. To read what references a record in every table, send "reference" without "table".
INVALID_PARAMETERKey "table" is required.
INVALID_PARAMETER"record_id" should be type: <string>. / "record_id" should only contain alphanumeric characters. / "unique_id" should be type: <string>.
INVALID_PARAMETER<value> is invalid in "table". allowed type or value is: Type<object>. (also for "index"; Type<string> for "reference")
INVALID_PARAMETER"index.value" should be type: number. (a $uploaded, $updated or $referenced_count query)
INVALID_PARAMETER"index.value" is required. / "index.range" type should match the type of "index.value".
INVALID_PARAMETER"tag" should be type: string.
NOT_EXISTSRecord does not exists. / Unique ID does not exists.
INVALID_REQUESTNo access to the record. / User has no private access.

deleteRecords ​

swift
func deleteRecords(_ query: JSON, fetchOptions: FetchOptions? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Signed-in only. Deletes your records, and their files, by:

query key
record_idstring, or an array of up to 1000
unique_idstring, or an array of up to 1000. Ignored when record_id is given.
table, index, tag, referencea query, as in getRecords; table is required, except with ["reference": ["user_id": <your own ID>]]. Deletes only your own records that are not read-only, in that one access group.

Returns the server's message as a JSON string, such as SUCCESS: records are being deleted. please give some time to finish the process., or an object with the deleted records in list when the server answers with them. Admins can delete any record. See Deleting records.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_PARAMETER"record_id" is empty. / "unique_id" is empty. ("" or [])
INVALID_PARAMETER"record_id" can hold at most 1000 ids.
INVALID_PARAMETER"record_id[<i>]" should only contain alphanumeric characters. / "unique_id[<i>]" should be type: <string>.
the query errors of getRecords

getTables ​

swift
func getTables(_ query: JSON? = nil, fetchOptions: FetchOptions? = nil) async throws -> JSON

No sign-in needed. Lists tables. See getTables.

query key
tableA table name. Left out: every table.
conditionLeft out: exact name. ">=" starts with, "<=" ends with, ">", "<", "=", "!=" and the word forms gt, gte, lt, lte, eq, ne.

Each item: {"table", "number_of_records", "size", "number_of_records_in_access_group_<group>"...}, with only the group counters the caller may see.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_PARAMETER"table" should not be empty. / "table" is required for condition.

getTags ​

swift
func getTags(_ query: JSON? = nil, fetchOptions: FetchOptions? = nil) async throws -> JSON

No sign-in needed. Lists tags. See getTags.

query key
tableLeft out: every table.
tagA tag.
conditionAs in getTables. Left out: exact when both table and tag are given, otherwise starts with.

With no query at all: every tag in the project, most used first. Each item: {"table", "tag", "number_of_records"}.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_PARAMETER"table" or "tag" is required for condition.

getIndexes ​

swift
func getIndexes(_ query: JSON, fetchOptions: FetchOptions? = nil) async throws -> JSON

No sign-in needed. Lists the indexes of a table. See getIndexes.

query key
tableRequired.
indexLeft out: every index. A name: that index exactly. A name ending with .: its children.
order["by", "value"?, "condition"?]. by: average_number, total_number, number_count, average_bool, total_bool, bool_count, string_count, index_name, number_of_records. value alone matches exactly; condition as in getTables. With index_name, ">=" is starts with and "<=" ends with.

Each item: {"table", "index", "number_of_records", "number_count", "boolean_count", "string_count", "total_number", "total_bool", "average_number", "average_bool"}.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_PARAMETER"table" is required.
INVALID_PARAMETER<value> is invalid in "order". allowed type or value is: Type<object>.
INVALID_PARAMETER"order.by" is required. / "<value>" is invalid in "by". allowed types or values are: ...
INVALID_PARAMETER"value" is required for "condition".
INVALID_PARAMETER"order.value" should be type: <string | number | boolean>.
INVALID_PARAMETER"index" should be a parent index name of the compound index when using "order.by" (an index not ending with .)

UploadFile ​

swift
struct UploadFile {
    init(name: String, file: FileSource, filename: String? = nil, contentType: String? = nil)
}

enum FileSource {
    case url(URL)            // a local file, read when the call runs
    case path(String)        // a path to a local file ("~" is expanded)
    case data(Data)          // bytes in memory: give a filename
    case stream(InputStream) // read to its end: give a filename
}
field
nameThe key the file is listed under in the record's bin, like a form field name. Several files can share one name.
fileWhere the bytes come from.
filenameThe stored file name. Required for .data and .stream; defaults to the file's own name otherwise.
contentTypeDefaults to a guess from the file name's extension.
swift
let files = [
    UploadFile(name: "picture", file: .url(photoURL)),
    UploadFile(name: "picture", file: .data(pngData), filename: "sunset.png"),
]

uploadFiles ​

swift
func uploadFiles(_ files: [UploadFile], recordId: String, service: String? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Attaches files to an existing record you can write. Returns:

json
{
    "completed": [filename, ...],
    "failed": [filename, ...],
    "errors": [{"file": filename, "name": key, "error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}, ...],
    "bin_endpoints": [url_or_empty_string, ...]
}

Files go up one at a time; a refused file does not stop the rest. See Adding files.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_PARAMETER"record_id" is required.
INVALID_PARAMETERthe files[<i>] errors of postRecord

getFile ​

swift
func getFile(_ url: String, expires: Double? = nil) async throws -> Data

Reads a record file by its url and returns its bytes, decrypted when it was encrypted on upload. See Downloading files.

expires (seconds) reads the file through a signed link instead of the signed-in session; making the link needs a signed-in user. See Links that work without sign-in.

For a private file you were granted access to, the SDK gets the private access key for you.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_PARAMETER"<url>" is an invalid url. / Invalid file url.
INVALID_PARAMETERExpires option can only be used on skapi cdn endpoints.
INVALID_PARAMETER"config.expires" should be > 0. (seconds)
INVALID_REQUESTUser login is required. (a file that is not public, or expires)
the storage's code, such as AccessDeniedan expired or refused signed link

getFileText ​

swift
func getFileText(_ url: String, expires: Double? = nil) async throws -> String

The same as getFile, read as UTF-8 text.

getFileEndpoint ​

swift
func getFileEndpoint(_ url: String, expires: Double? = nil) async throws -> String

A URL you can open: in an image view, a player, a share sheet. A "public" file's link is its plain CDN link. Another file's link carries the user's token and works while the session does. With expires (seconds) it is a signed link that works without signing in until then. A signed link passed back in is returned as it is. A link to an encrypted file downloads the encrypted bytes. Takes the errors of getFile.

getFileInfo ​

swift
func getFileInfo(_ url: String) async throws -> JSON

What a record file's URL says, read from the URL itself, with no download:

json
{
    "url": "https://...",
    "filename": "beach.jpg",
    "fileKey": "picture",
    "access_group": "authorized",
    "uploader": "<user id>",
    "record_id": "<record id>",
    "filesize": 482113,
    "uploaded": 1731600000000
}

downloadFile ​

swift
func downloadFile(_ url: String, to destination: URL, expires: Double? = nil) async throws -> URL

Reads the file like getFile and writes it to destination (replacing a file there). Returns destination.

deleteFiles ​

swift
func deleteFiles(_ endpoints: [String]) async throws -> JSON

Signed-in only. Deletes files by URL (up to 1000, from any records) and returns the updated records as a JSON array. A URL with a ?t= token (a file that is not public, or a link from getFileEndpoint) is turned back into the file's stored address, so names with spaces or non-English characters work. If any file is refused, none is deleted. See Deleting files by URL.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTThe record should be owned by the user.
INVALID_REQUESTOnly the owner of a private record can delete its files.
NOT_EXISTSRecord "<record_id>" does not exists.
INVALID_REQUESTInvalid endpoint / Cannot delete more than 1000 files at once.
INVALID_REQUEST"__data__/__json__.json" is a reserved file name.

grantPrivateRecordAccess ​

swift
func grantPrivateRecordAccess(_ params: JSON) async throws -> JSON

Signed-in only. params: ["record_id": String, "user_id": a user ID or an array of up to 100]. Returns the server's message. See Granting access.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_PARAMETER<value> is invalid in "record_id". allowed type or value is: Type<string>.
INVALID_PARAMETERUser ID is required. / Cannot process more than 100 users at once.
INVALID_PARAMETERUser ID in "user_id" is invalid.
INVALID_REQUESTRecord should be owned by the user.
INVALID_REQUESTPrivate access cannot be granted to service owners.

removePrivateRecordAccess ​

swift
func removePrivateRecordAccess(_ params: JSON) async throws -> JSON

Signed-in only. Same params and client errors as grantPrivateRecordAccess. Returns the server's message. The user cannot get a new private access key for the record after this, and a key they already hold stops working when it expires (within 1 hour).

On an encrypted record, the record's key is replaced first and the access is removed after, so if replacing the key fails, the access stays as it was.

listPrivateRecordAccess ​

swift
func listPrivateRecordAccess(_ params: JSON, fetchOptions: FetchOptions? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Signed-in only. params: ["record_id"?: String, "user_id"?: a user ID or an array], at least one. Each item in list has record_id and user_id. See Listing grants.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_PARAMETEREither record_id or user_id must be provided.
INVALID_PARAMETERuser_id should be type: <string | string[]> / User ID is invalid.

requestPrivateRecordAccessKey ​

swift
func requestPrivateRecordAccessKey(_ params: JSON) async throws -> String

Signed-in only. params: ["record_id": String, "reference_id"?: String]. Returns the key that opens the record's private files, and keeps it on the object. The key is valid for 1 hour; the kept key is returned until it is within a minute of expiring, then a fresh one is requested. getFile calls this for you. reference_id is the record the private record references, when your access comes from that record. See Private files.

Errors ​

codemessage
INVALID_PARAMETERRecord ID is required. / Record ID should be type: <string | string[]> / Reference ID should be type: <string>
INVALID_REQUESTUser's private access for record: "<record_id>" does not exist. / User's private access for reference: "<reference_id>" does not exist.
ERRORInvalid private access key response.
